question: Can defined PvLEA4 produce a reproducible bacterial-cellulose phenotype that is not explained by trehalose, generic protein loading, bulk pH/osmolarity, oxygen availability, or air-liquid interfacial effects?

public_evidence.finding: PvLEA4 is highly hydrophilic, becomes alpha-helical on drying, and limits growth of dehydration-induced protein aggregates in a dose-dependent manner.
Model LEA proteins preferentially adsorb to air-water interfaces and alter interfacial protection behavior.
public_evidence.boundary: This study did not test PvLEA4 or bacterial cellulose directly.

public_evidence.finding: Komagataeibacter-rich kombucha forms cellulose at interfaces; cellulose fibers become visible at the air-kombucha interface early in biofilm formation and interfacial tension was directly measured.
A non-nutritional silicone polyether surfactant lowered medium surface tension and increased BC yield and water-holding capacity in Komagataeibacter xylinus.
public_evidence.boundary: Surfactant behavior cannot be assumed to equal LEA behavior.

public_evidence.finding: Trehalose accumulation in agitated Gluconacetobacter xylinus was associated with a stress-protective metabolic branch and reduced carbon flux toward BC under those conditions.

mechanistic_paths.H1_interface: PvLEA4 -> air-liquid interface adsorption / surface-tension or interfacial-rheology change -> altered oxygen geometry -> altered cellulose deposition
mechanistic_paths.H2_direct_matrix: PvLEA4 -> direct cellulose/fibril or producer-surface interaction -> altered bundling/nucleation -> altered matrix phenotype
mechanistic_paths.H3_generic_protein: protein load rather than LEA identity -> altered medium/interface -> apparent BC phenotype
mechanistic_paths.H4_trehalose: trehalose/osmolarity/carbon carryover -> altered producer metabolism -> apparent PvLEA-associated phenotype
mechanistic_paths.H0: defined PvLEA4 produces no reproducible BC phenotype after matched controls

preregistered_conditions.role: interface-mediated positive reference; use only a validated material-compatible reference condition

dose_rule: LOW/MID/HIGH are frozen as relative tiers before BC outcome inspection. Exact concentrations must be chosen from solubility, protein availability, osmolarity and interface-measurement feasibility; outcome-driven dose tuning is forbidden.
primary_endpoint: dry_BC_mass normalized to matched batch and harvest rule
co_primary_mechanism_endpoint: surface_tension with oxygen proxy before substantial pellicle formation
batch_rule: No promotion from a single BC batch. Direction must reproduce across independent BC batches under the same frozen condition map.

decision_rules.pass_if: At least one frozen PvLEA4 tier reproducibly changes a BC endpoint versus baseline, vehicle, trehalose and generic-protein controls.
decision_rules.fail_if: PvLEA4 conditions are indistinguishable from matched controls across independent BC batches.

decision_rules.pass_if: PvLEA4 differs from the generic soluble-protein control in direction or dose-response after matched protein load and vehicle.
decision_rules.fail_if: Generic protein reproduces the full PvLEA4 phenotype.

decision_rules.pass_if: PvLEA4 effect persists after quantitative trehalose matching and is not reproduced by trehalose alone.
decision_rules.fail_if: Trehalose alone reproduces the phenotype or PvLEA4 loses the effect after trehalose matching.

decision_rules.pass_if: PvLEA4 alters interface/oxygen metrics in temporal order before the BC phenotype and a defined surface-tension reference phenocopies the material direction.
PvLEA4 changes BC structure after surface-tension, oxygen, pH, osmolarity, trehalose and generic-protein effects are matched or statistically separated.

kill_rules: If trehalose alone reproduces the PvLEA4 phenotype, reject a PvLEA4-specific interpretation.
If generic soluble protein reproduces the PvLEA4 phenotype, classify as GENERIC_PROTEIN_OR_INTERFACE_EFFECT rather than LEA-specific.
If all BC differences vanish after matching pH, osmolarity, oxygen and surface tension, reject direct matrix modification.
If a non-nutritional surface-tension reference reproduces the phenotype and PvLEA4 has no residual effect after interface matching, classify as INTERFACE_MEDIATED, not direct LEA-cellulose coupling.
If direction fails independent-batch replication, keep P0/P1 closed regardless of nominal significance in one batch.
No cell-free recovery fraction or recombinant-factor result may be called a Polypedilum-in-SCOBY effect.
safety_boundary: Contained non-pathogenic material research only. This artifact does not authorize environmental release or field deployment.
next_action: Run the frozen defined-factor matrix or obtain equivalent collaborator data; measure interface state before interpreting any BC morphology change.
